# Critical paths for the critical-gate check (Austin approved Nov 25, 2026).
# A PR that adds, changes, deletes or renames any matching file is CRITICAL: it cannot merge until
# Austin says "approve and deploy" and Elon records it (approve-critical.py). Everything else is routine
# and auto-merges after `test` passes and the Elon reviewer app approves.
# The gate always reads THIS file from main, so a PR cannot loosen its own gate; a change to this
# file is itself critical.
# Syntax: one pattern per line, matched against the full path from the repo root (case-insensitive).
#   *  = any characters except "/"     **/ = any folders (or none)     ** = anything
#   A pattern with no "/" only matches at the repo root (use **/name for any depth). # = comment.
#
# --- Always critical (all repos): workflows, deploy/CI config, this list, secrets ---
.github/**
.gitignore
**/.env*
**/*secret*
**/*credential*
**/*.pem
**/*.key
**/*.p12

# --- 12pointgetaways-site (public, guest-facing booking site) ---
# Netlify build/deploy config and headers
netlify.toml
package.json
package-lock.json
# Build: Hostfully API key use, booking widget (money), pages
build/**
site.config.mjs
# Routine: static/** (logo, styles), data/fixture.json, README.md
